thesis: AVGO는 v3.1에서 Growth 유형을 통과했고 Hard Veto 9개도 모두 cleared다. 구조적 AI 성장, 주당 현금창출, 경영진 실행력은 강하지만 FS 70·MT 68·AS 68로 완성도는 아직 중간 수준이며, downside skew 11.17과 Bear $137.04가 현재가 $357.61 대비 큰 하방을 보여준다. $126.8B 구매약정, $29B XPV backstop, 조건부 $42B customer notes, factoring까지 감안하면 Growth 초기 상한 1–3%를 그대로 쓰지 않고 STARTER 1–2%만 승인하며 macro pacing 0.5로 분할 집행한다.

evidence.claim: Aggregate score is 70.46 (Emerging Outlier); Growth is the only eligible archetype with deterministic fit score about 72.64.
All nine Hard Vetoes are CLEARED after ED/RT review, and core coverage is 100%.
Locked valuation is Bear $137.04, Base $404.48, Bull $797.84 versus frozen price $357.61; price/Base is 0.8841x.
Dispersion review shows mean downside skew 11.17, one-band reduction, with valuation the widest domain and asymmetry the most downside-skewed.
Q3/9M primary evidence shows 69% gross margin, 9M OCF $32.95B and strong AI growth, but also $126.821B purchase commitments, a maximum $29B XPV backstop and $3.95B of 9M receivables factoring.
Macro overlay leaves fundamental score unchanged but sets purchase pacing to 0.5 because geopolitical energy/shipping stress is the binding overlay.

counterevidence: Current price is below Base value, so AVGO has more valuation support than many high-growth peers.
69% gross margin, fast AI revenue growth and strong OCF argue that current demand is economically real rather than purely narrative.
Multi-generation custom-XPU programs and software contracts provide visibility beyond a single quarter.
XPV backstop is contingent, had no payments at quarter-end and was not recorded at a material fair value.
unknowns: XPV-supported customers' share of total revenue and AR.
How much of $126.8B purchase commitments is matched to non-cancellable customer obligations.
Actual funded loss exposure and recovery economics of the $29B backstop and any customer notes.
Independent customer-level XPU TCO/payback and long-run gross margin.
Normalized OCF/owner-FCF after removing factoring and working-capital timing effects.
falsifiers: AI semiconductor growth falls below 30% for two consecutive quarters while gross margin drops below 65%.
XPV-supported revenue/AR exceeds 25% or funded backstop/customer-note exposure rises materially while cash conversion weakens.
Owner FCF/share falls below the locked Base path across multiple periods and a refrozen Base value no longer exceeds market price.

key_kpis.name: Owner FCF/share vs locked Base path
key_kpis.threshold: stay on or above Base path after factoring normalization

key_kpis.name: XPV-supported revenue/AR and funded exposure
key_kpis.threshold: support-linked exposure <25%; no material funded loss

next_checks: Next 10-Q: XPV backstop, customer notes, purchase commitments, factoring and customer concentration.
Independent custom-XPU TCO/performance and customer payback evidence.
Refreeze valuation after FY2027 company guidance and normalized owner-FCF update.

plain_language.business: Broadcom은 데이터센터와 통신 장비에 들어가는 반도체, 맞춤형 AI 가속기와 네트워킹 칩을 만들고 VMware 기반 인프라 소프트웨어도 판매한다. 반도체와 소프트웨어 두 사업이 함께 현금을 만든다.
plain_language.opportunity: 현재 가장 큰 기회는 대형 AI 고객의 맞춤형 가속기와 이더넷 네트워킹 수요다. 장기 계약과 빠른 AI 매출 성장은 성장성을 뒷받침하고, VMware 소프트웨어는 별도의 현금흐름 원천을 제공한다.
plain_language.risk: 고객 집중이 높고, 대규모 구매약정과 AI 고객 지원 구조 때문에 AI 투자가 예상보다 둔화될 때 손실이 서로 겹칠 수 있다. 매출채권 factoring과 고객금융 구조 때문에 현금흐름의 질도 계속 확인해야 한다.
plain_language.decision_reason: 성장주 기준과 모든 중대 탈락 조건은 통과했지만 하방 시나리오가 넓고 재무·고객 집중 위험이 남아 있다. 그래서 초기 비중은 1~2% Starter로 제한하고, 현재 거시환경에서는 평소보다 절반 속도로 나눠 집행하는 결론이다.
